changelog: Tell /vibe who someone is to you, and your agent knows who to ask.
features: npx slashvibe-mcp who @handle "my dad; runs the business" keeps one private line about a person on this machine. Your agent sees it, so when the work needs "the owner" or "design" it can offer to ask the right person
The line is never sent by the package. An unattended answer over an open line refuses to carry it, and a draft that includes it says so before you choose Send
npx slashvibe-mcp who lists your notes; who @handle --clear removes one
